room_0.name: The Iron Cell
room_0.description: You wake up on a cold stone floor. Your face is locked in an iron mask, and your throat burns when you try to scream. Memory is gone, only blood remains.
room_0.betterDescription: You notice blood stains on the wall that match the scars on your hands. Near the heavy door, a rusty weapon lies waiting.

room_1.name: Ruined Gallery
room_1.description: A long corridor filled with broken statues of a faceless king. Shadows move in the dark, driven by endless hunger.
room_1.betterDescription: Behind a shattered sculpture of some forgotten queen, you see a small, glowing vial.

room_2.name: The Chapel of Tears
room_2.description: An ancient weeping priest sits near the ruined altar, whispering prayers to a silent God.
room_2.betterDescription: The priest ignores you, but behind his back, an ancient tome about blood essence is open.

room_3.name: The Shattered Throne Room
room_3.description: The heart of the castle. A colossal mutated beast guards a ruined throne. The air smells of old sins and fresh ash.
room_3.betterDescription: The beast holds a royal crest. This is the end of your short journey, or the start of a long penance.
